title: The Unsolved Mathematics Atlas
description: A reproducible, ranked, FAIR-indexed research dossier of 120 open mathematical problems across 38 fields (plus a daily full metadata mirror of all 25 Left to Solve programs / 59,396 targets), paired with a standalone eight-domain, six-kernel Lean 4.35.0 formal verification core with autoImplicit=false (66 headline theorems, 16 non-vacuity witnesses, 20 adversarial refutations = 102 audited declarations, including Complete Euclid-Euler even perfect number theorem, Euler's 1750 Mersenne divisor congruence 2p|(q-1), Collatz Fine-Wilf Odd-Unit-Lock valuation ceiling / exhaustive d<=7 & unconditional 1-/2-odd-step positive-cycle exclusion / catalytic reversible cylinders, full Lonely Runner through n=3, and exact Ramsey R(3,3)=6 & R(3,4)=9), live negative kernel rejection, automated primary-source citation and Crossref/DataCite retraction auditing, dual RFC 3161 + Bitcoin OpenTimestamps proofs, RO-Crate 1.1 and Croissant 1.0 metadata, a compiled AMS-LaTeX white paper, and a deterministic RAG corpus. Independent research; not peer-reviewed.

Human author directed conceptualization, scoping, formal statement-fidelity auditing, and curation; AI tools were used as disclosed drafting/engineering instruments (see CLAIMS.md, ERRATA.md, docs/LITERATURE_AND_EXPORT_CONTROL.md, and lean/formalization.yaml).
